text:
Next Thursday I'm moderating Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild.

Everyone has a demo that works. This session is about what happens after: what breaks when an AI agent moves from pilot to production, and who gets paged when it does.

Joining me on the panel:

→ Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company
→ Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which builds evaluation software for AI agents
→ Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

I'm curious how three very different seats (the business owner, the tooling builder, and the engineer on the hook) answer the same question. I suspect they won't fully agree, which should make for a good conversation.

📍 Co-working space in Chelsea, NYC
🕡 6:30 pm, next Thursday
🎟 Free, RSVP link in the comments

If you're taking an agent past the pilot stage, or you've already been woken up by one at 2 am, come say hi. And if there's a question you want put to the panel, drop it below and I'll work it in.
